summary: Moved all rounding into meterbill/money.py (exact integer arithmetic, no decimal context), removed the context line, and fuzz-checked CLI output identical to the original. Batch worker threads rounded half-even under the old context, so batch passes HALF_EVEN via new keyword-only parameters. Kept as-is: cash rule `whole` rounds half to even today (the guide says half up, but that would change figures), and its negative zero prints as 0.
